h:
支持视频转换为webp文件并保持动态效果

- 以30帧视频为例，选择每n个为5，就不会显得那么卡了。具体参数取决于输入视频帧率

- 输出宽度：默认768

- 转换后的webp帧率默认为8

o.en:
Support video conversion to webp file and keep dynamic effect

- Take 30-frame video as an example, select every nth as 5, it will not look so stuck. The specific parameters depend on the input video frame rate

- Output width: 768 by default

- The converted webp frame rate defaults to 8
